document: This meeting was about conceptual design. The user interface designer first introduced three concepts in the user interface - Google controller, fancy controller, and intelligent controller. The first two were approved by the project manager, but the last one was seriously questioned. The group finally decided to mix the Google controller and fancy controller with some simple vocal commands. The discussion about product industrial design covered three aspects —material, alimentation, and chip. The industrial designer suggested using wood and having buttons with LCD, applying the classical battery and solar energy alimentation, and using low level chips, which was agreed by the group. The marketing expert gave three points from the market analysis. Users would like to have a fancy look and feel and the product should be technologically innovative. At the same time, being user-friendly was also important. Then the group discussed how to make these requirements into practice.

decisions.decision: The pure intelligent controller concept was rejected in favour of a hybrid of the Google-style and fancy controllers with limited vocal commands.

alternatives.reason: interference, cost, language burden and unresolved hardware

rationale: Simultaneous use by several people would cause interference.
It would add a language and localisation burden.
The microphone and camera hardware questions were unresolved.

decisions.decision: Wood was chosen over plastic as the casing material.
Both battery and solar alimentation were adopted.
conditions: The design would increase the production cost, but this was treated as added value that can be compensated.
